## TemplateEngine.validateBlockMediaAttributes() method

Validates attributes on `<media>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockMediaAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

An object with a `valid` boolean and an `errors` array

## Remarks

Allowed attributes are `lang`<!-- -->, `type`<!-- -->, `src`<!-- -->, `shared`<!-- -->, `latitude`<!-- -->, `longitude`<!-- -->, `phone`<!-- -->, `first_name`<!-- -->, `last_name`<!-- -->, and `vcard`<!-- -->.

`shared` is a boolean attribute — it can be written as `shared`<!-- -->, `shared="true"`<!-- -->, or `shared="false"`<!-- -->. When `true`<!-- -->, the media item is included in all language variants of the enclosing `<media-group>`<!-- -->. Only valid inside `<media-group>`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validateBlockMediaAttributes(`<media type="photo" src="img.jpg">Caption</media>`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
```
